scripts.translation: 鍊金術士、生物化學家，以及更高階的職業基因學家都擅長製作藥水。 ^4d4dff^000000^4d4dff^000000^4d4dff^000000

scripts.text: If you want to have a well-made potion, it may be a good idea to ask for a specialist.
scripts.translation: 想做出品質上乘的藥水，找專家幫忙會比較好。

scripts.text: For emergency situations, in case you've fainted and want to be brought back here, I will save your current location.
scripts.translation: 道了...為了以防萬一，如果你昏倒後想回到這裡，我可以替你記錄當前位置。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too full so you can't continue this quest.
scripts.translation: 背包太滿，無法繼續任務。

scripts.text: Please try it again after organizing the items.
scripts.translation: 整理好物品後再試一次。

scripts.text: This Red Plant is no longer useful for you.
Aren't you here to collect the Red Plant for the Academy Therapist.
scripts.translation: 夠清楚嗎？你不是來替學院的治療師採紅草的嗎？

scripts.text: But, But something weird just happened.
scripts.translation: 可是、可是剛才發生了件怪事。

scripts.text: It happened right before my eyes.
scripts.translation: 那一幕我可是親眼看見的。

scripts.text: If the captain hears about it, he'll cry.
scripts.translation: 是船長聽說了，肯定會哭的。

scripts.text: It is still ok as long as I remember you.
scripts.translation: 不過，只要我還記得你就行。

scripts.text: Anyway, let me explain it to you, I have just cut all the leaves of this Red Plant.
scripts.translation: 總之，我解釋給你聽：我剛把這株紅草的葉子全剪掉了

scripts.text: You can't collect the Red Plant anymore.
Ok so give me a ^ff0000Red Herb^000000
scripts.translation: 那就給我一株紅色藥草 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: I don't even need it anyways. I already know all about basic medical botany.
scripts.translation: 那就...反正我也不需要。我已經學會所有基礎藥用植物知識了。

scripts.text: Then, why did you do it?
I guess you should go back to the Therapist.
scripts.translation: 我想你該回去找治療師了。他

scripts.text: He seems to think of something deeply.
scripts.translation: 他似乎在認真思考。先別
這個學生看起來有點眼熟...

scripts.text: - I swear on some old person's grave
scripts.translation: - 我對著某位老人的墳墓發誓

scripts.text: Yawn. Who are you making so much noise next to me...
scripts.translation: 哈啊。誰在我旁邊吵吵嚷嚷的...

scripts.text: Sorry for laughing. Ha ha ha!
I was just taking a nap because the weather is good.
scripts.translation: 哈！天氣這麼好，我只是打了個盹。

scripts.text: Right it makes sense that you misunderstood.
scripts.translation: 個啊？這麼說來，難怪你會誤會。

scripts.text: I used the skill<^ff0000Play Dead^000000> because I didn't want to be disturbed by monsters or someone else.
scripts.translation: 我用了<裝死>技能，這樣魔物或其他人就不會來打擾我。 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: I never thought someone would think of me as an actual dead body.
scripts.translation: 我還真沒想到會有人把我當成屍體。

scripts.text: Oh, I see... you are a new novice who just has arrived here?
scripts.translation: 哦，原來如此...你是剛到這裡的初心者吧？

scripts.text: I guess it is unexpected and surprising but do you want to learn <^ff0000Play Dead^000000>?
scripts.translation: 這確實有點出乎意料。你想學<裝死>嗎？ ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: I am sure that it will help you. How do you think about it?
scripts.translation: 我保證這技能對你有幫助。你覺得怎麼樣？

scripts.text: I am sorry but I am busy.
Really ? If you are busy then fine by me.
scripts.translation: 真的？你要是忙的話，那就算了。我

scripts.text: I want to teach you for good.
A novice does not know the potential power of himself nor how strong the enemy is.
scripts.translation: 初心者往往不瞭解自己的潛力，也不清楚敵人有多強。

scripts.text: There is a studious type of novice who studies well..but i guess we are not.
scripts.translation: 有些初心者很愛鑽研...不過我想我們都不是那種人。

scripts.text: And sometimes you'll be defeated by stong enemies...
scripts.translation: 動。不過，有時也會被強敵打敗...

scripts.text: Huh? You're right this is my story.
scripts.translation: 嗯？你說得沒錯，這說的就是我

scripts.text: I was getting sick of being defeated.
scripts.translation: 。我都快受夠一次次被打敗了。

scripts.text: One day, a good idea came to my mind. If I pretend to be dead when I find a strong enemy...
scripts.translation: 有一天，我靈機一動：遇到強敵時，乾脆假裝自己已經死了...

scripts.text: I was faced with the risk of death, because I was not good at pretending to be dead.
scripts.translation: 因為我不擅長裝死，好幾次都險些喪命。現在回

scripts.text: Even when I look back at that time. it is still thrilling...
scripts.translation: 想起來，還是讓人心驚膽戰...

scripts.text: So ever since then, Playing Dead started working out for me!
scripts.translation: 那以後，我的裝死戰術就越來越管用了！

scripts.text: I could not hold a breath for a long time.
Clever monsters were checking out my breath!
scripts.translation: 機靈的魔物會察覺到我的呼吸！

scripts.text: So I had to train myself to hold my breath for a long time.
scripts.translation: 所以我只好訓練自己，儘可能長時間地屏住呼吸。

scripts.text: Sounds complicated.. but it is quite simple.
scripts.translation: 聽起來很複雜...其實很簡單。

scripts.text: If you feel like you can not beat the enemy, when a strong one appears, just fall down on the ground and pretend to be dead.
scripts.translation: 如果遇到強敵，覺得自己打不過，就倒在地上裝死吧。

scripts.text: I will put you on a brief test whether you hold you breathe or not.
scripts.translation: 我來簡單測試一下你能不能屏住呼吸。

scripts.text: Hold a breath for 20 seconds, then talk to me later. I won't admit you if you talk to me before that time is over!
scripts.translation: 屏住呼吸 20 秒，之後再來找我。在時間到之前來找我的話，我可不會讓你通過！

scripts.text: What? You aren't able to hold your breath for even 20 seconds?
scripts.translation: 什麼？你連20秒都撐不住？你得

scripts.text: You can't learn this skill until you are able to hold it!
scripts.translation: 先學會屏住呼吸，才能學這招！

scripts.text: If you have strong patience like that, it will save you. There will be no monsters that can hurt you.
scripts.translation: 不錯。只要有這樣的耐心，就能在危急時救自己一命，讓魔物拿你沒辦法。

scripts.text: The <^ff0000Play Dead^000000> skill is in your skill list which you can open by pressing <Alt + S>, Please do not forget to use it, it will save you when you are in a danger.
scripts.translation: <裝死>技能已加入技能列表，按<Alt + S>即可開啟。遇到危險時別忘了使用，它能救你一命。 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: If you grow up and get another job, then you do not need this skill so do not spare it! Wse it when you need to and don't hesitate.
scripts.translation: 等你成長並轉職後，就用不上這技能了。需要時儘管用，別猶豫！

scripts.text: I need to get some sleep, do not wake me up. Yawn.
scripts.translation: 我得睡一會兒，別吵醒我。哈啊...

scripts.text: I am in charge guiding you here in the Academy.
scripts.translation: 過得怎麼樣？我負責帶你熟悉學院。

scripts.text: Welcome to our Academy. I am in charge with the guide and registration for Novice education courses.
scripts.translation: 歡迎來到學院。我負責指引初心者教育課程，併為學員辦理報名。

scripts.text: What can I do for you?
- As you are overloaded with too many items, quest can't be continued.-
scripts.translation: - 背包裡的物品太多，無法繼續任務。-

scripts.text: Let me see... Your name is... {0}.
I will make a new registration for you.
You can choose the course freely and each course has individual features.
scripts.translation: 記。你可以自由選擇課程，每門課程都有各自的特色。

scripts.text: And this is the basic equipment for the educational course.
scripts.translation: 這是教育課程的基礎裝備，請好好

scripts.text: Please make a good use of it.
Be careful with it as it won't be provided again.
scripts.translation: 保管，之後不會再次發放。

scripts.text: It is your first step to be an adventurer that you have made a visit to us.
scripts.translation: 來這裡拜訪，就是你成為冒險者的第一步。

scripts.text: On our next meeting, I anticipate you will grow up a bit more.
scripts.translation: 希望下次見面時，你已經又成長了一些。

scripts.text: One who is not a Novice can't attend the educational course.
scripts.translation: 非初心者不能參加教育課程。

scripts.text: However, a part of the educational course except the character cultivation can be freely attended. So, you may look around the Academy and neighboring places.
scripts.translation: 不過，除了角色培養之外，其他教育課程都可以自由參加。你可以去學院和附近轉轉。

scripts.text: The first floor is equipped with instructors that give you lessons on how the world works here in Midgard.
scripts.translation: 一樓有指導員，會為你講解米德加爾特的世界和基礎知識。

scripts.text: First of all, at the dispensary, you can learn how to recover your physical strength and learn a skill to heal your HP
scripts.translation: 首先，在醫務室可以學習如何恢復體力，以及治療 HP 的技能。

scripts.text: At the armory, you can get simple training about battling monsters in Midgard.
scripts.translation: 在武器庫可以接受基礎訓練，學習如何在米德加爾特與魔物戰鬥。

scripts.text: At the cafeteria, you can practice cooking and and will learn its many benefits.
scripts.translation: 在餐廳可以練習烹飪，並瞭解烹飪的各種好處。

scripts.text: At the 2nd floor, there are trainers that will teach you about the different job classes in the world.
scripts.translation: 二樓有職業導師，會為你介紹這個世界的各種職業。

scripts.text: Listen to the trainers and decide for yourself which job suits your personal style.
scripts.translation: 聽聽導師們的介紹，再選擇最適合自己風格的職業吧。

scripts.text: This town is called 'Izlude' the satellite and port city of the Capital City of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom Prontera.
scripts.translation: 這裡叫依斯魯得，是盧恩·米德加茲王國首都普隆德拉的衛星城和港口城市。

scripts.text: This town was re-organized to suit the education of Novices.
scripts.translation: 這座城鎮經過重新規劃，方便初心者在此接受教育。

scripts.text: Please find me, if you need anything else.
scripts.translation: 還有其他需要的話，隨時來找我。

scripts.text: Left-Click your mouse on the name of the trainer you are looking for and I will give guide you to them.
scripts.translation: 點選你想找的導師姓名，我就會為你指路。
練師<NAVI>[泡芙]<INFO>iz_ac02,143,55</INFO></NAVI>，職業適性測試導師

scripts.text: I believe you'll become nicer on our next meeting. Try your best~~~
scripts.translation: 希望下次見面時，你能變得更加出色。加油~~~

scripts.text: Please find me, if you need anything else.
scripts.translation: 還有其他需要的話，隨時來找我。

scripts.text: Left-Click your mouse on the name of the trainer you are looking for and I will give guide you to them.
scripts.translation: 點選你想找的導師姓名，我就會為你指路。

scripts.text: I believe you'll become nicer on our next meeting. Try your best~~~
scripts.translation: 希望下次見面時，你能變得更加出色。加油~~~

scripts.translation: 還有其他需要的話，隨時來找我。

scripts.translation: 還有其他需要的話，隨時來找我。

scripts.text: Please find me, if you need anything else.
scripts.translation: 還有其他需要的話，隨時來找我。

scripts.text: What should I do with this lunchbox?
- As you are overloaded with too many items in your inventory -
scripts.translation: 下！！- 你的背包物品太多了- 已經

scripts.text: - You can't receive the items anymore -
scripts.translation: 無法再領取物品- 請先整

scripts.text: Are you ready to learn about abnormal statuses? I promise that I won't trick you anymore. I am a ''trainer'' after all right?
scripts.translation: 準備好了解異常狀態了嗎？我保證不再捉弄你了。畢竟我可是個“導師”，對吧？

scripts.text: First of all, I'll tell you about <^FF0000Poison^000000>.
scripts.translation: 首先，我來給你講講<中毒>。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: As you already experienced, when you are poisoned, your body turns purple and you lose a little HP every second.
scripts.translation: 就像你剛才體驗到的那樣，中毒後身體會變成紫色，而且每秒都會損失少量 HP。

scripts.text: You can't lose HP forever so you won't die from poison.
scripts.translation: HP 不會一直減少，所以中毒不會致命。

scripts.text: Experiencing is believing! I will put you in a poisoned status.
scripts.translation: 實踐出真知！我現在就讓你進入中毒狀態。

scripts.text: See what happens to you in the poisoned status.
scripts.translation: 看看你處於中毒狀態時會有什麼反應。

scripts.text: Did you see what is the poisoned status? After a certain period of time, you could be detoxicated, but if you're being attached, it is dangerous to expect being detoxicated naturally.
scripts.translation: 看清中毒狀態的效果了嗎？過一段時間後，毒素可能會自行消退；但如果這時還在持續受攻擊，就別指望它會自然消退了。

scripts.text: Refer to the detoxicants such as <^0022FFGreen Herb^000000>, <^0022FFGreen Potion^000000>, <^0022FFPanacea^000000> and <^0022FFRoyal Jelly^000000>.
Next, I'll tell you about<^FF0000 Stun^000000.
scripts.translation: 接下來，我來給你講講< 眩暈>。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: While in the Stun status, stars will circle around your head and you can't move basically you'll be ''defenseless''.
scripts.translation: 眩暈時，你的頭頂會有星星打轉，而且基本無法移動，完全處於“毫無防備”的狀態。

scripts.text: As you are defenseless, you can't move, use skills, and use items.
scripts.translation: 毫無防備時，你無法移動、使用技能或物

scripts.text: So, it is impossible to recover from it by yourself.
scripts.translation: 品，因此沒辦法自行解除狀態。

scripts.text: The exceptional case is you can recover from it by the skill called <^0022FFGentle Touch-Cure^000000> if you are a Sura.
scripts.translation: 有個例外：如果你是修羅，可以使用<點穴-快>技能解除眩暈。 ^0022FF^000000

scripts.text: You can recover with skills such as the Priest's <^0022FFRecovery ^000000> or the Arch Bishop's <^0022FFLauda Ramus^000000>.
scripts.translation: 也可以使用牧師的<恢復>或大主教的<折枝讚頌>等技能解除。 ^0022FF^000000^0022FF^000000

scripts.text: Let me show you what will happen in the Stun status!
scripts.translation: 讓我演示一下眩暈狀態的效果！

scripts.text: Didn't you feel oppressed since you couldn't move?
Imagine that you are in that status and monsters are rushing to you...
scripts.translation: 想像一下，你動彈不得時，魔物正朝你衝來...相信

scripts.text: This time, I will teach you about <^FF0000Sleep^000000>.
scripts.translation: 接下來，我要教你關於<睡眠>的知識。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: In Sleep status, you fall asleep with a <Zzz> popped up over your head.
scripts.translation: 進入睡眠狀態時，你會睡著，頭上還會冒出一個<Zzz>。

scripts.text: Same as the Stun status, you are defenseless, but the difference is you can recover from the enemy's attack.
scripts.translation: 和眩暈時一樣，你會毫無防備；不同的是，受到敵人攻擊後你就會醒來。

scripts.text: But in Sleep status, the possibility to be hit by ''Critical'' attacks from enemy's attack is increased, you are in danger and exposed a severe damage.
scripts.translation: 不過，睡眠狀態下更容易受到敵人的暴擊，處境會很危險，也可能遭受重創。

scripts.text: For your reference, recovery by yourself is impossible and is only possible with the <^0022FF Recovery ^000000>skill of a Priest.
scripts.translation: 提醒你一下，睡眠狀態無法自行解除，只能靠牧師的<恢復>技能解除。 ^0022FF^000000

scripts.text: Let me show you what will happen in the Sleep status.
scripts.translation: 讓我演示一下睡眠狀態的效果。

scripts.text: How was it? It isn't fun to imagine being asleep in front of a dangerous enemy is it?
scripts.translation: 怎麼樣？想像一下在危險的敵人面前睡著，不太好受吧？

scripts.text: Sleep is good for recovery but not necessarily good while you're in the middle of a battle.
scripts.translation: 睡眠有助於恢復，但在激烈的戰鬥中可不是什麼好事。

scripts.text: Lastly, I will teach you about  <^FF0000 Silence ^000000>.
scripts.translation: 最後，我來講講<沉默>狀態。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: In Silence status,  you can't use any magic skills and a <...> will appear above your head.
scripts.translation: 進入沉默狀態後，你無法使用任何魔法技能，頭頂還會出現一個<...>。

scripts.text: But all attacks are not impossible. Normal attacks can still be done while silenced.
scripts.translation: 不過，沉默並不會讓你無法攻擊，仍然可以進行普通攻擊。

scripts.text: In the silence status, you can merely still physically attack or recover by using potions.
scripts.translation: 沉默狀態下，你只能進行物理攻擊，或者使用藥水恢復。

scripts.text: It's possible to recover with the items such as<^0022FF Green Herb^000000>, <^0022FFGreen Potion^000000>, <^0022FFPanacea^000000> and <^0022FFRoyal Jelly^000000>.
Let me show you what will happen in Sleep status.
scripts.translation: 讓我演示一下睡眠狀態的效果。

scripts.text: It's frustrating to not be able to use your skills right?
scripts.translation: 不能使用技能，是不是很令人著急？

scripts.text: Especially, when you are a high class depending upon the skills rather than physical attacks or in Sleep status during the battle, you will be damaged severely.
scripts.translation: 尤其是依賴技能而非普通攻擊的高階職業，或在戰鬥中陷入睡眠時，都會因此遭受重創。

scripts.text: In addtion, there are other statuses like Darkness, Frozen, Curse, Stone, Confusion etc, but I can let you experience all of them.
scripts.translation: 此外還有黑暗、冰凍、詛咒、石化、混亂等狀態，我也可以讓你逐一體驗。

scripts.text: I hope this was helpful for you to experience some of the things that you will see out in the world.
scripts.translation: 希望這次體驗能幫你提前熟悉今後冒險中會遇到的狀況。

scripts.text: Whenever you want to experience an abnormal status, please come to me.
scripts.translation: 想體驗其他異常狀態時，隨時來找我。

scripts.text: As an apology for the lunchbox matter, I will give you a small gift.
scripts.translation: 之前便當盒的事是我不好，就送你一份小禮物賠罪吧。

scripts.text: Wish you have good luck in your adventures!
By any chance, are you a training beginner?
scripts.translation: 你是剛來學院的新手訓練生嗎？

scripts.text: I'm Trainer Mainz; and I'm in charge of education at this Academy.
scripts.translation: 我是教官美因茨，負責這所學院的教學工作。

scripts.text: It is not important so I will let you know later.
scripts.translation: ？現在還不重要，之後我再告訴你。

scripts.text: You must be very exhausted after having to read and learn so much right?
scripts.translation: 讀了這麼多、學了這麼多，一定很累吧？

scripts.text: Of course, you are... Oh, you poor thing.
There's a person who can help you when you need it.
scripts.translation: 你需要幫助時，有個人能幫你。

scripts.text: Do you know who is it?
It means I have prepared a special gift just for your exhausted self!
scripts.translation: 意思？我特地為疲憊的你準備了一份禮物！
給你準備了便當！！！哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text: Since I'm not the one who made it don't worry.
scripts.translation: 放心，不是我做的。這是我親

scripts.text: My beloved wife prepared it. So, just be my guest and enjoy!
scripts.translation: 愛的妻子準備的。來，別客氣，儘管享用！

scripts.text: You don't want to have this lunchbox? I guess it's your loss then.
scripts.translation: 你不想要這個便當？那可就虧大了。

scripts.text: Should I just take it for myself then?
Yes... You made a right decision.
Please keep in mind that I really wanted to have it but since you look exhausted I offered it to you first!
scripts.translation: 智的決定。可別忘了，我其實很想吃；不過看你這麼累，才先讓給你！

scripts.text: - You open the lunchbox and there is some type of food inside -
scripts.translation: - 你開啟便當盒，發現裡面裝著某種食物 -

scripts.text: Wahahahat! Don't hesitate and just take it!
scripts.translation: 哇哈哈！別猶豫，快吃吧！吃

scripts.text: It will refresh you from your fatigue!
- Since you're tired and starved you're obliged to take the box -
scripts.translation: - 你又累又餓，只好收下便當盒 -

scripts.text: - You eat the food and suddenly feel a sharp pain in your stomach. Your vision seems to be blurry too -
scripts.translation: - 你吃下食物後，胃裡突然一陣劇痛，視線也開始模糊 -

scripts.text: I will give you an antidote. You might get better if you take it.
scripts.translation: 我給你一劑解毒藥，服下後應該會好些。
- 你不情願地服下了解毒藥 -

scripts.text: Well, how the heck were you poisoned?
By the way, I heard that there's a ghost wandering around the Royal Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation: 對了，我聽說皇家克里阿圖拉學院裡有幽靈出沒。

scripts.text: I think the ghost must have poisoned you.

scripts.text: All right, do you see those ^3131FFFire Eggs^000000 over there?

scripts.translation: 給你。現在再去攻擊火蛋，應該能造成更多傷害。

scripts.text: There is only one more chance!
Hurry up, the attribute magic will be gone if you take more time thanks for joining to my class.
scripts.translation: ！快點，再磨蹭下去屬性魔法就要消失了。謝謝你來上課！

scripts.text: Go and smack those eggs over there.

scripts.translation: 螞蟻蛋很堅固，不用怕把它們打壞。

scripts.text: There is nothing I can do. But I will help you anytime if you need.
scripts.translation: 我幫不了你更多。不過，你隨時可以來找我求助。

scripts.text: Magic basically consists of different attribute attacks. There is another way of giving the attribute to your weapon by using skill or item. You will learn more the longer you play. Good luck!
scripts.translation: 魔法基本上都是屬性攻擊。也可以通過技能或道具改變武器的屬性。玩得越久，你就會懂得越多。祝你好運！

scripts.text: Are you getting interested in the depth of the different attributes?
scripts.translation: 你開始對各種屬性的奧妙感興趣了嗎？

scripts.text: Why are you carrying so much stuff?
scripts.translation: 行李帶得太多了。先放下

scripts.text: Put them down and come back.
Various dishes to stimulate the five senses. Oh, its heaven!
scripts.translation: 各式料理，刺激你的五感...啊，簡直是天堂！

scripts.text: It's not an accident that you came here!
scripts.translation: 你能來到這裡絕非偶然！

scripts.text: I am Dacquoise, the pupil of the legendary chef of Rune-Midgarts, ^0000cdCharles Orleans^000000.
scripts.translation: 我是達克瓦茲，盧恩·米德加茲王國傳奇主廚查爾斯·奧爾良的弟子。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: And we are also club members of Sir Orleans' ^0000cdfan club- Loverleans^000000.
scripts.translation: 我們也是奧爾良爵士粉絲俱樂部“戀奧爾良”的成員呢！ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Orlean belongs to all of us!
scripts.translation: 奧爾良爵士可是屬於大家的！

scripts.text: Ah, what do all the fools of the land eat?
Fruits? Of course you can eat it raw, but isn't it art when you see the red strawberries laying on top of a creampie?
scripts.translation: 水果？當然可以直接吃，不過看到紅豔豔的草莓鋪在奶油派上，不覺得像一件藝術品嗎？

scripts.text: Bread? Of course you can eat it plain, but can you resist the fantastic harmony of meat and cheese and vegetables in a perfect sandwich?
scripts.translation: 麵包？當然可以直接吃，但你能抵擋完美三明治中肉、乳酪與蔬菜交織出的絕妙滋味嗎？

scripts.text: I like the steamed horse feet of Minourus!
scripts.translation: 我喜歡吃清蒸米洛斯馬蹄！

scripts.text: If you eat a dedicated meal, you can ^0000cdraise a specific stats^000000 and additionally, ^0000cdrecover your health^000000, so what's the reason not to cook?
scripts.translation: 吃一頓精心烹製的料理，既能提升特定屬性，還能恢復體力。這樣你還有什麼理由不下廚？ ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.translation: 我有預感，你還會再回來的！

scripts.text: Don't forget to pound your chest if you choke on sweet potato!

scripts.text: Ok, we will be kind guides to the journey of cooking!!

scripts.text: It's ok with me, asking me everthing you want to know.

親切就是我們的調味料~

scripts.text: Aha! You want to know about the benefits of cooking? Cooked meals have two benefits!

scripts.text: Cooking is divided into 6 catagories. Each will raise up ^0000cdStr, Agi, Vit, Int, Dex, Luk^000000.
scripts.translation: 料理分為六類，分別提升力量、敏捷、體質、智力、靈巧和幸運。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: The amount of the stat increase changes depending on the level of cooking.

scripts.text: This also differs with cooking levels, and some only recover HP.

scripts.text: Your level is too low to experience the effects right now. If you level up more you will experience and cry for the effect of cooking.

scripts.text: I won't stop you even if you stay still...
scripts.translation: 續原地踏步...我也不會攔著你...

scripts.text: Try to talk to ^ff0000each job instructor^000000 on the 2nd floor of the Academy if you aren't sure what job you want still.
scripts.translation: 如果你還沒決定想轉哪個職業，可以去學院二樓和各職業導師聊聊。 ^ff0000^000000
我是戰鬥指導員蘇比諾 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: I ^ff0000provice a simple request^000000 to help you to grow up as good a soldier as fast as you can, so look around.
scripts.translation: 0000。為了幫你儘快成長為優秀的戰士，我會發布一些簡單的委託，四處看看吧。 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: The most delicious in the world (1~3)
^ff0000Poring^000000s are very cute monsters when you see them.
scripts.translation: 波利看起來都是非常可愛的魔物。 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: They drop Jellopy which are regarded as a main cooking material in Criatura Academy so we always need to hunt Porings.
scripts.translation: 波利會掉落傑勒比結晶，這是克里阿圖拉學院常用的烹飪材料，所以我們總得去狩獵波利。

scripts.text: ^ff0000Lunatic^000000s are very cute animal that live near Prontera.
scripts.translation: 瘋兔是生活在普隆德拉附近的可愛動物。 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: Tender...Soft...Very cute... It is very cute........
scripts.translation: 軟綿綿...軟乎乎...超可愛...可愛極了...

scripts.text: It always bring ^ff0000Carrot^000000s with it, so it is easy to get a delicious carrot by hunting them.
scripts.translation: 瘋兔總帶著胡蘿蔔，狩獵它們就能輕鬆獲得美味的胡蘿蔔。 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: A carrot has lots of fibrous cells and contains vitamin A and carotin so it is good for eyes!
scripts.translation: 胡蘿蔔富含膳食纖維，還含有維生素 A 和胡蘿蔔素，對眼睛很有好處！

scripts.text: ^ff0000Fabre^000000 is the most common bug which is usually seen in Rune-Midgarts Kingdom..
scripts.translation: 綠棉蟲是盧恩·米德加茲王國最常見的蟲子。 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: It is a worm but it is very popular because it looks cute.
scripts.translation: 雖然是隻蟲子，卻因為長得可愛而很受歡迎。

scripts.text: Most of the clothes provided by Criatura Academy are made from ^ff0000Fluff^000000 from Fabres. It makes very strong and warm fabric.
scripts.translation: 克里阿圖拉學院的大部分制服，都是用綠棉蟲掉落的絨毛製成的。用它織出的布料既結實又保暖。 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: ^ff0000Pupa^000000 is the intermediate stage of a Fabre before transforming into a Creamy.
scripts.translation: 蟲蛹是綠棉蟲變成克瑞米之前的 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: The process of a larva turning into a buttefly is mysterious.
scripts.translation: 階段。幼蟲蛻變成蝴蝶的過程真是奇妙。

scripts.text: As a Fabre transforms to a Creamy I hope that all Novices turn to be great adventurers! So ^ff0000Chrysalis^000000.
scripts.translation: 就像綠棉蟲會變成克瑞米，我也希望所有初心者都能成長為優秀的冒險者！所以，來一場蛻變吧。 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: ^ff0000Hornet^000000s are a group of bees that live near Prontera under control of the Queen bee Mistress.
scripts.translation: 蜂兵是生活在普隆德拉附近、受蜂后妖后統領的蜂群 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: Not aggressive... They only attack with their stingers when they are in danger.
scripts.translation: 。它們通常不會主動攻擊，只有感到危險時才會用毒針反擊。

scripts.text: There is a study about using the poison extracted from their stingers to make an antidote in Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation: 克里阿圖拉學院正在研究如何利用蜂兵毒針中的毒液製作解毒劑。

Come back again if you change your mind.
scripts.translation: 改變主意的話，歡迎再來。

scripts.text: Ok, I'll send you to the West field of Izlude.
scripts.translation: 好，我送你去依斯魯得西部野外。

scripts.text: Be sure you know how to get back.
scripts.translation: 記得先弄清楚該怎麼回來。

scripts.translation: 你還沒在克里阿圖拉學院 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: It requires a simple procedure so go and register.
scripts.translation: 註冊嗎？手續很簡單，去辦一下就好。

scripts.text: You can register at the ^ff0000information center of academy^000000.
scripts.translation: 可以在學院諮詢中心註冊。 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: You don't seem to need my help.
scripts.translation: 看來你不需要我的幫助

scripts.text: You'd better look around somewhere else or go to the wider world.
scripts.translation: 。不妨去別處看看，或是踏上更廣闊的世界。

scripts.text: Visit the ^ff0000support of the class guild (Lv. 10~20) or check out the Eden Group (Lv. 15~100)^000000.
scripts.translation: 前往職業公會支援處（等級 10～20）或樂園團（等級 15～100）。 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: ^ff0000Ask the staff of each job on the second floor about the location of each class guild^000000 and you will find the ^ff0000Eden Group Headquarters^000000 where you can find easy hunt quests.
scripts.translation: 向二樓各職業的導師打聽職業公會的位置，之後就能找到樂園團總部，那裡有簡單的狩獵委託。 ^ff0000^000000^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: It is ^ff0000displayed in the map of right screen^000000, so search for it.
scripts.translation: 位置會顯示在螢幕右側的小地圖上，仔細找 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: If you do not know, then you should get a help from a ^ff0000Town Guide^000000.

scripts.text: Any questions about getting a monster to become a pet?
scripts.translation: 想知道如何把魔物馴養成寵物嗎？

scripts.text: Only some monsters can become pets and they all have different things to tame them.
scripts.translation: 只有部分魔物可以成為寵物，而且每種魔物需要的馴服道具都不一樣。

scripts.text: Each monster that can be tamed requires a specific ^3131FFtaming item^000000.
scripts.translation: 每種可馴服的魔物都有對應的馴服道具。 ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: ^3131FFdouble click^000000 the taming item in your inventory and select which monster to tame.
scripts.translation: 先在背包裡雙擊馴服道具，再選擇目標魔物。 ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: Press ^3131FFClick^000000 in the center of the pop-up slot machine to tame the monster..
scripts.translation: 點選彈出的老虎機視窗中央的“點選”按鈕，就能嘗試馴服魔物。 ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: If successful, the monster will be tranformed into an egg!
scripts.translation: 馴服成功後，魔物就會變成寵物蛋！

scripts.text: Hatching requires you to have a ^3131FF<Pet Incubator>^000000 to awaken a monster in the egg.
scripts.translation: 要孵化寵物蛋，必須持有<攜帶用孵蛋器>，才能喚醒蛋裡的魔物。 ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: Most towns have a ^3131FF<Pet Groomer>^000000 where you can buy the ^3131FF<Pet Incubator>^000000.
scripts.translation: 大多數城鎮都有<寵物美容師>，能在那裡買到<攜帶用 ^3131FF^000000^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: Ask the town guide for the location of the Pet Groomer if you can't find them.
scripts.translation: 孵蛋器>。找不到的話，可以向城鎮嚮導打聽寵物美容師的位置。

scripts.text: ^3131FFRight-click^000000 on your pet and select ^3131ffCheck the Pet Status^000000 to check on its status. Or you can press ^3131FF<Alt+J>^000000.
scripts.translation: 右鍵點選寵物，再選擇檢視寵物狀態即可檢視狀態。也可以按<Alt+J>。 ^3131FF^000000^3131ff^000000^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: This will open up the Status Window. Here you can change the pet's ^3131FFname^000000 as well as check their ^3131FFHunter^000000 and ^3131FFIntimacy^000000.
scripts.translation: 這樣會開啟狀態視窗。在這裡可以更改寵物的名字，檢視它的飢餓度和親密度。 ^3131FF^000000^3131FF^000000^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: There are some special pets that gives special skills when their ^3131FFIntimacy^000000 level becomes Loyal. Most pets start off as shy and time and food changes that.
scripts.translation: 有些特殊寵物的親密度達到“忠誠”後會學會特殊技能。大多數寵物一開始都很怕生，隨著時間推移並餵食，就會逐漸親近你。 ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: <Pet Food> is normal food for pets but some pets prefer other foods. You should keep enough with you so your pet doesn't get hungry.
scripts.translation: <寵物飼料>是寵物的常見食物，但有些寵物偏愛其他食物。記得隨身帶夠食物，別讓寵物餓著。

scripts.text: Pets will ^3131FFrun away^000000 if they are too full or too hungry. So make sure you check your pets hunger status frequently!
scripts.translation: 寵物太飽或太餓都會逃跑。記得經常檢視寵物的飢餓度！ ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: Some pets will show a special performance when they are in a good mood.
scripts.translation: 有些寵物心情好時會做出特別的動作。

scripts.text: Some pets can even wear accessory items.
scripts.translation: 有些寵物還能佩戴飾品。

scripts.text: ^3131FF<Pet Groomer>^000000 will sell some pet accessory items but some monsters will also drop pet accessory items as well.
scripts.translation: <寵物美容師>會出售寵物飾品，有些魔物也會掉落。 ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: I think it is better off experiencing more together than transforming back to the eggs?
scripts.translation: 比起把寵物變回蛋，不如繼續一起冒險、創造更多回憶吧？

scripts.text: Come back again when you have another question.
scripts.translation: 還有問題的話，隨時再來找我。

scripts.text: I am hungry~ Feed me first, then let's walk around~
scripts.translation: 我餓了~先餵我吃點東西，再帶我出去逛逛吧~

scripts.text: Calm down now, here you go!
Phew, it was good. I'm full.
Pets make the best companions for lonely journeys...
scripts.translation: 寵物是孤獨旅途中最好的夥伴...

scripts.text: Once it was a dangerous monster, now it is my closest friend. This is my ^3131FFpet^000000 which is called as Debbie Ruchi.
scripts.translation: 它曾是危險的魔物，如今卻成了我最親密的夥伴。這就是我的寵物，名字叫黛比·魯奇。 ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: Yawn~ I am bored to death!
Well they're loyal ^3131FFmonster^000000s that stand by your side.
scripts.translation: 寵物是忠誠的魔物，會一直陪伴在你身邊。 ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: It doesn't help me battle but it helps by giving me bonus ^3131FFstats^000000 and other bonus effects.
scripts.translation: 它不會幫我戰鬥，但能提供額外的屬性和其他增益效果。 ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: All these things are possible when ^3131FFIntimacy^000000 with your pet is very high.
scripts.translation: 只要和寵物的親密度足夠高，就能獲得這些效果。 ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: Intimacy requires a time commitment and a lot of food. Food is the way to any being's loyalty right? ha ha
scripts.translation: 培養親密度需要花時間，也得準備很多食物。俗話說，想收服誰的心，就先餵飽誰，對吧？哈哈。

scripts.text: How do I get a pet?
Pets make the best companions for lonely journeys...
scripts.translation: 寵物是孤獨旅途中最好的夥伴...

scripts.text: Hmm then let's go to the Academy Gardens together!
scripts.translation: 那我們一起去學院花園吧！

scripts.text: I'll show you how it's done.
Talk to me when you are ready to go to the garden!

scripts.text: Shall we go to the garden of Criatura Academy?

scripts.text: If you want, I will guide you anytime.

scripts.text: Would you look at that...Porings growing in the garden of the closed Criatura Academy like little Jelly Babies.

scripts.text: Not all monsters in Midgard are our for your blood, just most of them.

scripts.translation: 去醫務室學學怎麼製作青蘋果吧。 ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: One of the staff there should have a ^3131FFItem compounding book^000000 for novices, ^3131FFHow to make Unripe Apples^000000 is one of the subjects.
scripts.translation: 那裡的工作人員應該有初心者用的物品合成書，裡面就有青蘋果的製作方法。 ^3131FF^000000^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: So you used the taming item on the Little Porings, then they turned into eggs?
scripts.translation: 你把馴服道具用在寶貝波利身上，它們就變成蛋了？

scripts.text: Ha ha ha, don't fret my pet.
scripts.translation: 哈哈，別擔心，小傢伙。你剛通

scripts.text: Yep, it means you are ready to be a friend like me and Debbie Ruchi.
scripts.translation: 沒錯，這說明你也能像我和黛比·魯奇一樣，和寵物成為朋友了。

scripts.text: There are lots of different monsters and tames out there.
scripts.translation: 外面有各種各樣的魔物，也有不少可以馴服的夥伴。

scripts.text: If you successfully tame it you end up with a little egg.
scripts.translation: 成功馴服魔物後，就能得到一顆寵物蛋。

scripts.text: So congratulations again for passing the test, the friendship test!
scripts.translation: 再次恭喜你通過考驗，成為寵物的朋友！

scripts.text: Ask anytime whenever you have a question about cute pets.
scripts.translation: 想了解可愛寵物的話，隨時來問我。

scripts.text: Do you see the shivering poring over there? Go easy on the lil' blighter, okay?
scripts.translation: 看到那隻發抖的波利了嗎？對它溫柔點，別嚇著它，好嗎？

scripts.text: Dear oh dear...what do we have 'ere?
Wot a sad state of affairs.
That geeza' ghostring got defeated out in his dungeon and came here to pick on other monsters like me.
scripts.translation: 那個混賬幽靈波利在迷宮裡被打敗後，跑來這兒欺負我這樣的魔物。

scripts.text: I'm too low level to stop 'im, you can hear them cheering now...
scripts.translation: 我的等級太低，攔不住它。你聽，他們現在又在歡呼了...

scripts.text: Oi you lot! Tell me wot I want to hear!
scripts.translation: 喂，你們這群傢伙！說點我愛聽的！

scripts.text: Ello' mate. Were you successful? Where are the lil' bleeders?
scripts.translation: 嘿，夥計，成功了嗎？那些小傢伙在哪兒？

scripts.translation: 你對笨拙的波利做了什麼？！初心者！！！！！

scripts.text: I used the unripe apples that you gave me, then they turned into eggs.
scripts.translation: 我用了你給我的青蘋果，它們就變成蛋了。

scripts.text: Oh, guess I didn't expect they'd be turned into pets so easily!
scripts.translation: 哦，沒想到這麼容易就能把它們變成寵物！

scripts.text: Yeah, don't worry, I'll make sure to

scripts.translation: 可能會失敗，但繼續嘗試把那些寶貝波利引過來吧！

scripts.translation: 你聽說過從初心者成長為老練冒險者的過程嗎？

scripts.translation: 就得好好照顧你的寶貝波利！

scripts.text: Even before that Ghostring came here, the Little Porings were kind of cowardly.
scripts.translation: 即使在幽靈波利來這裡之前，寶貝波利就已經有點膽小了。

scripts.translation: 你才剛開始冒險吧？以後會走訪許多城鎮、結識許多人，還會遇上可怕的頭目魔物。

scripts.translation: 要不要帶一隻這樣的可愛小傢伙一起旅行？

scripts.text: They're smeggin' talkative, but they'll be loyal friends!
scripts.translation: 它們雖然話很多，卻會是忠實的夥伴！

scripts.text: I'd say that the ^31311FAdept adventurer ^000000knows lots of things about pets, so you can ask him about your new Little Poring Friend.

scripts.translation: 我還會送你寶貝波利最愛喝的蘋果汁，記得按時餵它！ ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: I look forward to seeing you once you've explored Midgard!

scripts.text: Take good care of your Little Poring. Ask the adept adventurer if you have any questions about cute pets!

scripts.text: First, you need to complete your^8B4513 registration^000000 at the Academy's front desk.
scripts.translation: 首先，請到學院前臺完成註冊 ^8B4513^000000

scripts.text: If you go to the first floor,
You are the just a beginner.
Everything looks new and unfamiliar, doesn't it? Isn't it all exiciting?
scripts.translation: 一切都新鮮又陌生，對吧？是不是很令人興奮？

scripts.text: What can be a more exciting start than a marriage in your life?
scripts.translation: 人生中還有什麼比結婚更令人期待的開始呢？

scripts.text: I am the Wedding Secretary sent here for those people wanting to join their lives to another.
scripts.translation: 我是婚禮秘書，專門為想與伴侶共度一生的人提供服務。

scripts.text: Please ask anything you are concerned with about marriage!
scripts.translation: 關於結婚有任何疑問，儘管問我！

scripts.text: Concluding the ceremony between two lovers is really the most beautiful and special event in one's life.
scripts.translation: 為一對戀人主持婚禮，是人生中最美好、最特別的時刻。

scripts.text: However, being together requires several procedures.
scripts.translation: 不過，想要結為夫妻還得辦理幾項手續。

scripts.text: First, the two of you wishing to get married have to be at least base level ^0000cd45^000000 or higher, meaning  you should be at the level responsible for your life and your finances.
scripts.translation: 首先，想結婚的雙方基礎等級都必須達到45級以上，也就是說，你們都已具備獨立生活和理財的能力。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Next, you need to prepare some tokens of appreciation. Men need a ^0000cdTuxedo^000000 Ladies need a ^0000cdWedding Dress^000000 and both need to have ^0000cdDiamond Ring^000000s as the symbol of everlasting love.
scripts.translation: 接下來要準備一些信物：男士需要燕尾服，女士需要結婚禮服，雙方還都要有象徵永恆愛情的鑽石戒指。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You will also need to provide a fee of ^0000cd1 million Zeny^000000.
scripts.translation: 另外還要支付100 萬 Zeny手續費。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Having prepared all of these things, you must create a party with just the two of you and go to the ^0000cdProntera Cathedral^000000.
scripts.translation: 準備好這些之後，你們兩人組成一支隊伍，再前往普隆德拉大教堂。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: There, another  ^0000cdWedding Secretary^000000 like me is wating for you. When you speak to her, she will give more details of what to do.
scripts.translation: 那裡會有另一位婚禮秘書等著你們。和她交談，她會告訴你們詳細流程。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I hope that you will meet a great fiance and enjoy a happy marriage!
scripts.translation: 希望你能遇見一位好伴侶，擁有幸福美滿的婚姻！

scripts.text: To say the least, the benefit of marriage is being together forever!
scripts.translation: 婚姻最大的好處，就是兩個人能永遠相伴！

scripts.text: After the wedding ceremony, you can enjoy a sweet honeymoon at the ^0000cdJawaii^000000 resort only for you.
scripts.translation: 婚禮結束後，你們還能到只屬於兩人的爪哇度假村享受甜蜜蜜月。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: And, upon marriage you will both get a ^0000cdspecial skill^000000.
scripts.translation: 結婚後，雙方都會獲得一項特殊技能。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Two of these skills are called ^0000cdLoving Touch^000000 and ^0000cdUndying Love^000000 which are used to sacrifice HP or SP and send it to your partner.
scripts.translation: 其中兩項技能是隻呵護妳和只為你犧牲，可以消耗自己的 HP 或 SP 轉給伴侶。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: But among them, the skill called ^0000cdRomantic Rendezvous^000000 is the most romantic one, enabling you to summon your partner to you from anywhere in the world.
scripts.translation: 其中最浪漫的要數浪漫約會，能讓你從世界各地召喚伴侶到身邊。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Aren't these skill great? Don't you want to get married right now?
scripts.translation: 這些技能很棒吧？你們不想馬上結婚嗎？

scripts.text: Being together is wonderful but people without experience of it in the past couldn't understand the full Euphoria of being a parent.
scripts.translation: 相伴左右固然美好，但沒有親身體驗過的人，很難體會為人父母的全部喜悅。

scripts.text: Married couple can adopt other characters as their children.
scripts.translation: 已婚夫婦可以收養其他角色作為自己的孩子。

scripts.text: ^0000cdKids of extended jobs such as Taekwon boy/girl, Gunslinger or Ninja can't be adopted^000000.
scripts.translation: 跆拳少年/少女、神槍手或忍者等擴充套件職業無法被收養。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: And any prospecting parents need to be at least base level  ^0000cd70^000000, meaning you should be at the level responsible enough to be parents.
scripts.translation: 想收養孩子的準父母，基礎等級都必須達到70級以上，才算有能力承擔父母的責任。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Having made a family, ^0000cdaSkill to be used among the family^000000 will be earned.
scripts.translation: 組建家庭後，你們還能獲得一項家族專屬技能。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: There is another skill enables you to concrete your bond such as being able to summon your child when you miss them or not losing your earned level if you die during battle.
scripts.translation: 還有一項技能能讓家人之間的羈絆更深，比如在想念孩子時召喚孩子，或是在戰鬥中倒下時避免損失等級。

scripts.text: Cute charms coming from your kid is a bonus~
scripts.translation: 還能享受孩子帶來的可愛樂趣呢~

scripts.text: Your mother didn't teach you right?
Mercy on you. You are ignorant of the beauty of love!!!
scripts.translation: 真可憐，竟然不懂愛情有多美好！！！

scripts.text: Did you see Etinifni playing at the backyard?
scripts.translation: 你看到埃蒂尼夫尼在後院玩嗎？

scripts.text: He's out again? Never stays in the house!! Shall I use it?
scripts.translation: 他又跑出去了？真是一刻也待不住！！要不要用那個把他叫回來？

scripts.text: Leave him alone~ He may be playing somewhere.
scripts.translation: 別管他啦~他可能在哪兒玩呢。

scripts.text: Ah... Again!! I have been out hunting Orcs.
scripts.translation: 啊...又來了！！我剛才還在外面打獸人呢。

scripts.text: I told you stop hunting! Go and buy us milk!
scripts.translation: 我說過別再打怪了！快去給我們買牛奶！

scripts.text: Why am I just your errand boy? Go, get me a brother!
scripts.translation: 為什麼我整天只能給你跑腿？不如給我生個弟弟！

scripts.text: I am sorry... Dad has no power over your mom.
scripts.translation: 抱歉...爸爸也管不了你媽媽。

scripts.text: Got this boy ten years ago after years of childlessness.
scripts.translation: 我們多年都沒能有孩子，十年前才終於有了這個男孩。

scripts.text: He is the apple of my eyes to me, but my wife is too strict on him.
scripts.translation: 他是我的心肝寶貝，可我妻子對他管得太嚴了。

scripts.text: So, I am always worrying if the only son might be spoiled.
scripts.translation: 所以我總擔心這個獨子會被寵壞。
也許每個父母都會這樣擔心吧？

scripts.text: Once you have time, come to Orc Dungeon!
scripts.translation: 有空的話來獸人地下城找我！

scripts.text: Let's go~~ together hand in hand~~ Put everything aside ~~ in the dark blue night of Jawaii~~ under the stars~~

scripts.text: We are leaving for Jawaii-the place of our honeymoon to celebrate our 10th wedding anniversary!
scripts.translation: 我們要去爪哇——當年我們度蜜月的地方，慶祝結婚十週年！

scripts.text: Are you lifting up our good old memories renting my wedding dress and your tuxedo!! It will strenghthen our relationship, won't it?
scripts.translation: 穿上我的婚紗和你的燕尾服，重溫當年的美好回憶吧！！這樣肯定能增進感情，對吧？

scripts.text: No!! I love you more than you do!!
Shout like this when I miss you, honey!!
scripts.translation: 想我的時候，就這樣大聲喊我，親愛的！！

scripts.text: Then, you run towards me leaving everything behind,~ don't you?
scripts.translation: 到時候你會拋下一切，朝我飛奔而來，對吧？~

scripts.text: I will definitely do as you call me!!
scripts.translation: 只要你呼喚我，我一定會立刻趕來！！

scripts.text: You are tired of sitting, aren't you?
Yes, thank you for sharing your SP! You are also tired, aren't you?
scripts.translation: 謝謝你把 SP 分給我！你也累了吧？

scripts.text: It's one of the second jobs after Merchant.
scripts.translation: 術士。這是商人的二轉職業之一。

scripts.text: I feel that quiet places help to increase the rate of success.

scripts.translation: 他明明可以安全精煉裝備...真不懂為什麼要冒這種險。

scripts.translation: 啊哈，沒什麼，沒什麼。講給這些不懂的人聽也沒用。

scripts.text: Ah! I happened to come up with another great poetic inspiration.. Take a memo.. Memo..
scripts.translation: 啊！我又有了絕妙的詩歌靈感...快記下來...記下來...

scripts.text: There is a town called Payon to the east. Taking a long way to the south, you can even reach Alberta.
scripts.translation: 東邊有座斐揚城。一路往南走遠些，還能到達艾爾貝塔。

scripts.text: Payon is the wonderful city. There you can be transferred to an Archer or to a Taekwon. And a nice Dungeon there. If you have time, please make a visit.
scripts.translation: 斐揚是座很棒的城市，可以在那裡轉職為弓箭手或跆拳。那兒還有座不錯的地下城。有空一定去看看。

scripts.text: Class aptitude test is nonsense for those who already have a job.
scripts.translation: 已經有職業的人，做職業適性測試也沒意義。

scripts.text: You haven't decided your job yet?
scripts.translation: 你還沒決定要轉什麼職業嗎？

scripts.text: Have you already decided? Ok then.
scripts.translation: 你已經決定好了？那好吧。

scripts.text: I wanted you to take the Class aptitude test for fun...
scripts.translation: 我本來還想讓你做個職業適性測試，玩一玩呢...
知道什麼是職業適性測試 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: I have one book left. Do you want to try? I won't say it will be help for sure but it will be fun.
scripts.translation: 0000嗎？我這裡還剩一本測試手冊。想試試嗎？雖然不保證一定有幫助，不過肯定挺有意思。

scripts.text: The Class aptitude test is a test for recommending jobs by reviewing your personality and capability with the answers.
scripts.translation: 職業適性測試會根據你的回答評估個性和能力，並推薦適合的職業。

scripts.text: It has 3 types of test and each one give 30 minutes to finish.
scripts.translation: 測試分為三種，每種都要在30分鐘內完成。

scripts.text: If you have free time and have not decided your job... how about taking this test?
scripts.translation: 如果你有空，又還沒決定要轉什麼職業...不如來做做測試？

scripts.text: The first type of question is about taking an action for a given situation.
scripts.translation: 第一類題目會描述一種情境，再問你會採取什麼行動。

scripts.text: In the middle of the dark, you're walking on the street of Prontera when suddenly you hear someone scream.
scripts.translation: 夜色漆黑，你走在普隆德拉的街上，忽然聽見有人尖叫。

scripts.text: You run to the place and see someone surrounded by punks. Because of your sudden appearace, the punks are surprised.
scripts.translation: 你趕到現場，發現有人被一群朽魔圍住。你的突然出現讓朽魔們吃了一驚。

scripts.text: What would be your reaction to this situation?
scripts.translation: 遇到這種情況，你會怎麼做？

scripts.text: After clear up the mess, you approach the person who was being attacked.
scripts.translation: 解決眼前的麻煩後，你走近那個被襲擊的人

scripts.text: Do you think the person who was surrounded by punks is a man or a woman?
scripts.translation: 。你覺得被朽魔圍住的是男人還是女人？

scripts.text: The situation of encountering the gangs were like this
scripts.translation: 事情是這樣的：你遇上了一夥幫派成員。

scripts.text: You find out that {0} is the {1} of very rich family in Alberta and Punks attacked while {2} was on an errand for the family
scripts.translation: 你得知是艾爾貝塔一個富裕家族的，當替家族辦事時遭到了朽魔襲擊。 {0}{1}{2}

scripts.text: What kind of errand was he doing?
For your bravery, {0} becomes your friend and decides to go on a trip.
scripts.translation: 你的英勇表現讓成為了你的朋友，並決定出門旅行。{ {0}

scripts.text: You're having a great time. Do you feel like something will be happening or not?
scripts.translation: 你玩得正開心。你覺得接下來會發生什麼嗎？

scripts.text: Now for the second test. Choose the best answer in your own opinion.
scripts.translation: 接下來是第二項測試。請憑直覺選出你認為最合適的答案。

scripts.text: 2nd type of question is to select a word or sentence which is closest to yourself.
scripts.translation: 第二類題目要從詞語或句子中，選出最符合你自己的那一項。

scripts.text: 2nd type of question is done. It was simple. Right ? Let's move to next.
scripts.translation: 第二項測試結束了。很簡單吧？那我們繼續下一項。

scripts.text: Now for the third test. Please choose (Yes) or (No) to each question.
scripts.translation: 接下來是第三項測試。請對每個問題回答“是”或“否”。

scripts.text: Do you always pick up money that you find on the ground?
scripts.translation: 你總會撿起掉在地上的錢嗎？

scripts.text: If you had the same name as someone of the opposite sex, would that make you less attracted to them?
scripts.translation: 如果某個異性和你同名，你會因此對他（她）失去好感嗎？

scripts.text: Do you like to be able to carry a lot of items at once?
scripts.translation: 你喜歡一次攜帶很多物品嗎？

scripts.text: Do you like to read books?
You read everything in a magazine?
scripts.translation: 你會把雜誌從頭到尾都讀完嗎？

scripts.text: Do you take the time to worry about what you are wearing?
scripts.translation: 你會花時間琢磨自己該穿什麼嗎？

scripts.text: Do you tell others what kind of fancy foods you've eaten recently?
scripts.translation: 你會和別人聊起最近吃過的美食嗎？

scripts.text: Do you write things down in a notebook often?
scripts.translation: 你經常把事情記在筆記本上嗎？

scripts.text: Do you like to be in areas where a lot of people gather?
scripts.translation: 你喜歡待在人多熱鬧的地方嗎？

scripts.text: Do you like the idea of living a single life?
Do you like to keep your distance from others?
scripts.translation: 你喜歡和別人保持距離嗎？

scripts.text: Do you think that having a good hiding space is important in battle?
scripts.translation: 你認為戰鬥時有個藏身之處很重要嗎？

scripts.text: Would you defend your friend even if you knew they were wrong?
scripts.translation: 即使知道朋友做錯了，你也會站出來維護他嗎？

scripts.text: Would you try to convince an enemy not to fight you with logic?
scripts.translation: 你會試著講道理，說服敵人別和你交手嗎？

scripts.text: Can you sit still in the same place for a long time?
scripts.translation: 你能長時間待在同一個地方一動不動嗎？

scripts.text: Do you think that you can take a punch straight to the gut from an Orc?
scripts.translation: 你覺得自己能硬扛獸人迎面打來的一拳嗎？

scripts.text: Do you make up nicknames for your friends?
Do you always have a plan B for various situations?
scripts.translation: 遇到各種情況時，你都會準備好備用方案嗎？

scripts.text: I think about something else while talking to others.
scripts.translation: 和別人交談時，我常常會想著別的事情。

scripts.text: Class aptitude test is finished with 1,2 and 3rd test. Please wait for a moment.
scripts.translation: 職業適性測試的三部分都完成了。請稍等片刻。

scripts.text: It requires to manually calculate as you know.
scripts.translation: 你也知道，得手動算一下才行。

scripts.text: Finished calculating. Math is always difficult.
According to the Class aptitude test!
scripts.translation: 根據職業適性測試的結果...

scripts.text: The one who wants to be a hero with stong belief and wants to influence on the world.
scripts.translation: 你堅信自己能成為英雄，並希望改變世界。

scripts.text: The one who wants to protect the weak.
The one who is curious about knowing everything and independently work alone.
scripts.translation: 你對一切都充滿好奇，喜歡獨立完成事情。

scripts.text: the one who has good judgement, not out-going, analyzing and insightful and likes to observe...
scripts.translation: 你判斷力出色，性格內斂，善於分析和觀察，洞察力也很敏銳...

scripts.text: The one who is romantic and understands the feeling of others and tries to be understood by others as well.
scripts.translation: 你富有浪漫情懷，既能體會他人的感受，也希望別人理解自己。

scripts.text: The one who wants to spend time finding out who they are.
scripts.translation: 你願意花時間認識真正的自己。

scripts.text: the one who is good at reading the mind of others and is decisive.
scripts.translation: 你善於洞察人心，做事果斷。

scripts.text: the one who is strongly interested in achieving and target-driving and responsible.
scripts.translation: 你渴望有所成就，目標明確，也富有責任感。

scripts.text: The one who wants to have fun is optimistic who loves adventure.
scripts.translation: 你樂觀開朗、熱愛冒險，總想盡情享受生活。

scripts.text: The one who wants to find out something exciting and wants to donate to the world in his own way.
scripts.translation: 你喜歡尋找新鮮刺激，也想用自己的方式回饋世界。

scripts.text: The one who has a great heart to help others and understand.
scripts.translation: 你心地善良，樂於助人，也善解人意。

scripts.text: The one who wants to be loved and wants to care for others.
scripts.translation: 你渴望得到關愛，也願意關心他人。

scripts.text: the one who has sound mind from right training.
scripts.translation: 你經過適當的訓練，擁有健全的心智。

scripts.text: The one who tries hard everyday with certain belief and tries to make people understand.
scripts.translation: 你懷著堅定的信念，每天努力不懈，也努力讓別人理解自己。

scripts.text: The one who is called as a justice giver but also gives chaos and fear.
scripts.translation: 你被稱為正義使者，卻也會帶來混亂與恐懼。

scripts.text: The one who tries to balance between justice and chaos.
scripts.translation: 你努力在正義與混亂之間尋求平衡。

scripts.text: The one who does not want to get attention.
and who is persistant without giving up until reaching the target.
scripts.translation: 你堅持不懈，直到達成目標。

scripts.text: ^8014EB{0}^000000 is a good matching job for you.
You do not have to choose the job from Class aptitude test. That is only just for fun.
scripts.translation: 你不必選擇職業適性測試推薦的職業，那只是供你參考、圖個樂而已。

scripts.text: If you want, I will send it to the class that was recommended by the aptitude result.
scripts.translation: 如果你願意，我可以送你去推薦職業的轉職導師那裡。
沒關係，我還想再考慮一下。

scripts.text: Ok, you know what you want I guess.
scripts.translation: 好吧，看來你心裡已經有主意了。

scripts.text: Your recommended job is {0}. I will send you to where you can talk to that job professional.
scripts.translation: 為你推薦的職業是。我會送你去見這類職業的導師。 {0}

scripts.text: - Quest can't be continued as your overloaded items. -
scripts.translation: - 背包超重，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text: Oh! I am sorry but in order to take the class, y'all have to register first. Ya come back here after registration at that there counter on the 1st floor, ya hear?
scripts.translation: 哎呀，真抱歉！想參加轉職考核，得先登記才行。先去一樓櫃檯登記，登記好再回來，聽見了嗎？

scripts.text: Gosh Darnit! You are cuter then a piglet! Are ya trying ta learn to be a ^ff0000Gunslinger^000000?
scripts.translation: 天哪！你可比小豬崽還招人喜歡！你想學神槍手嗎？ ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: You're so cute! A ^ff0000Gunslinger^000000 who has true grit wield his weapons bringing justice in these wild times.
scripts.translation: 你真可愛！真正的神槍手膽識過人，在這亂世中揮槍懲惡揚善。 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: Ya, know you remind me of my little brother, that varmint couldn't shoot the broadside of a barn.. at least not until I taught him.
scripts.translation: 你知道嗎？你讓我想起我弟弟。那小子以前連穀倉都打不中...直到我教會他為止。

scripts.text: Ya, know you remind me of my little sister, that scamp couldn't shoot the broadside of barn.. At least not until I taught her.
scripts.translation: 你知道嗎？你讓我想起我妹妹。那丫頭以前連穀倉都打不中...直到我教會她為止。

scripts.text: Now y'all need to understand, guns aren't some little thing that you just swing at an animal, you don't wiggle those there fingers and shock them to death.
scripts.translation: 你們得明白，槍可不是拿來對著動物亂揮的小玩意兒，也不是動動手指就能把人電死的東西。

scripts.text: No! You shoot things, which means ya need to aim straight. This takes a lot of ^ff0000dexterity^000000 on the part of the gunslinger.
scripts.translation: 不對！槍是用來射擊的，所以瞄準一定得準。這就要求神槍手有很高的靈巧。 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: Now before ya go running off shooting dem guns in the air, all high fallootin and dancing around. Ya need to understand that this isn't an easy job!
scripts.translation: 別急著跑出去朝天開槍，擺出一副了不起的樣子又蹦又跳。你得先明白，這行可沒那麼容易！

scripts.text: Bullets cost zeny so you need to be sure that everything you shoot is worth the price! We attack at range so that nasty cur with the pig sticker doesn't rustle your jimmies!
scripts.translation: 子彈要花錢，所以每一發都得打得值！咱們從遠處攻擊，拿刀的惡棍就沒法湊上來找你麻煩！

scripts.text: Those low tech barbarians need both Strength and Dexterity in order to fight properly. This isn't true for gunslingers.
scripts.translation: 那些落後的野蠻人得靠力量和靈巧才能好好戰鬥，神槍手可不一樣。

scripts.text: Why our dexterity influences both attack power and accuracy! Remember, Talk slowly but think quickly!
scripts.translation: 因為靈巧既影響攻擊力，也影響命中率！記住：說話慢一點，思考快一點！

scripts.text: Do y'all see lots of factories around here? Mines? Alchemical labs? All these things take zeny to run and thats how they fund it!
scripts.translation: 你們看看這附近有多少工廠、礦場和鍊金實驗室？這些都得花錢才能運轉，咱們的子彈錢就是這麼來的！

scripts.text: Some other jobs may think it is safe enough to hand any yonkle the strength to seriously hurt someone.
scripts.translation: 有些職業覺得，隨便讓什麼人擁有足以重傷他人的力量也沒關係。

scripts.text: But we have to see that you have grit! Remember, fast is good but accurate is better.
scripts.translation: 可我們得先看看你有沒有膽識！記住，速度快固然好，打得準更重要。

scripts.text: Y'all can come back now if you gets any more questions.
scripts.translation: 以後還有問題，隨時回來找我。

scripts.text: They tell me Criatura Academy is for the novices not yet decided what job to take.
scripts.translation: 聽說克里圖拉學院專門接收還沒決定轉什麼職業的初心者。

scripts.text: They hired me, gun and all, to show you how to be a gunslinger!
scripts.translation: 他們把我連人帶槍一起請來，就是要我教你們怎麼當神槍手！

scripts.text: Would you like me to show you how?
Hrmm, you didn't look like you had the grit any how.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我就覺得你沒那股膽氣。

scripts.text: Hey! What kind of con is this?! You already had a manual!
scripts.translation: 喂！這算什麼把戲？！你不是已經有手冊了嗎？

scripts.text: Here take this manual, I ain't too good at that there book learnin' but I can answer your questions.
scripts.translation: 拿著這本手冊吧。我不太會讀書，不過你有問題儘管問我。

scripts.text: If you need the battle training, visit <NAVI>[Subino]<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation: 需要戰鬥訓練的話，就去找<NAVI>[蘇比諾]<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text: Oh, sorry! Children cannot become Gunslingers!
scripts.translation: 哦，抱歉！小孩子不能成為神槍手！

scripts.text: Perhaps you should talk to your parents about other professions.
scripts.translation: 或許你該和父母商量一下，看看還有哪些職業適合你。

scripts.text: Are you going to learn to shoot as a gunslinger?
scripts.translation: 你想學射擊，成為神槍手嗎？

scripts.text: Wooo doggy! You aren't ready for the big city yet!
scripts.translation: 哎喲喂！你還沒準備好去大城市闖蕩呢！

scripts.text: Get to ^ff0000Job Level: ^0000ff10^000000 and come back here and I will help ya!
scripts.translation: 先升到職業等級：10，再回來找我，我就幫你！ ^ff0000^0000ff^000000

scripts.text: Y'all ready to take the test to become a gunslinger?
scripts.translation: 你們準備好參加神槍手轉職考核了嗎？

scripts.text: When ya are ready, come to me!
Okay then, you should find a^ff0000 Mr. Master Miller^000000 and ask him about the test.
scripts.translation: 那好，你去找米勒大師，問問他轉職考核的事。 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: Remember, if you find yourself in a hole, the first thing to do is stop digging!
scripts.translation: 記住，發現自己陷進坑裡時，第一件事就是別再往下挖！

scripts.text: Y'all need help with that book?
scripts.translation: 那本手冊有什麼不懂的，儘管問我。

scripts.text: How do I use this book?
Oh.. I think I know what the problem is,
scripts.translation: 哦...我想我知道問題出在哪兒了。

scripts.text: Ta use the guide, first ya need to equip it. ^ff0000To open the equipment window the Shortcut key is Alt + E.^000000
scripts.translation: 要用這本指南，得先把它裝備上。按 Alt + E 可以開啟裝備視窗。 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: Sometimes I forget ta do that too! ^ff0000Drag the item from your inventory to the appropriate slot in the equipment window. Alternatively you can double click the item in inventory.^000000
scripts.translation: 我有時也會忘了這一步！把物品從背包拖到裝備視窗對應的欄位裡就行，也可以在背包裡雙擊物品。 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: Do ya have any other questions?
scripts.translation: 還有別的問題嗎？[露莎]有問題的話，隨時可以回來找我。

scripts.text: Y'all need ta learn how to use the skill?
scripts.translation: 想學怎麼使用這個技能嗎？

scripts.text: ^ff0000To open the skill window use the short cut Alt + S. The skill will be located in the ETC tab.^000000
scripts.translation: 按 Alt + S 開啟技能視窗，然後在 ETC 標籤頁裡找到這個技能。 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: ^ff0000You can then drag the skill to your hot bar for easy use!.^000000
scripts.translation: 把技能拖到快捷欄上，用起來就方便多了！ ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: ... and thats how I learned that When in doubt, let your peco do the thinkin'.
scripts.translation: ...我就是這麼學會的：拿不定主意時，就讓你的大嘴鳥替你動腦筋。

scripts.text: Do ya have any other questions?
scripts.translation: 還有別的問題嗎？[露莎]有問題的話，隨時可以回來找我。

scripts.text: Well, I don't think that you are quite ready to get a shootin iron. So the training book only shows ya skills that don't need guns.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我看你們還沒準備好拿槍。所以這本訓練手冊只介紹不需要槍械的技能。

scripts.text: Do ya have any other questions?
scripts.translation: 還有別的問題嗎？[露莎]有問題的話，隨時可以回來找我。

scripts.text: If ya need more questions you can always come back ta me.
scripts.translation: 有問題的話，隨時可以回來找我。

scripts.text: Oh! Are you just darling, a newly minted gunslinger!
scripts.translation: 哎呀！新晉神槍手真討人喜歡！

scripts.text: Why your shootin iron looks shinier then a silver zeny! Do ya need anything?
scripts.translation: 喲，你那把槍亮得都快趕上銀幣了！需要什麼幫忙嗎？

scripts.text: Can you help me get to Einbroch?
scripts.translation: 能送我去艾音布羅克嗎？

scripts.text: Sure, why not? Make sure to spend some time trainin!
scripts.translation: 當然行！記得多花點時間練習！

scripts.text: Oh, I am glad to hear that you are so strong!
scripts.translation: 哦，聽說你這麼厲害，我真替你高興！

scripts.text: Ah, still in basic training eh? You're not carelessly using Butterfly Wings, right?
scripts.translation: 啊，還在進行基礎訓練呀？你沒隨便用蝴蝶翅膀吧？

scripts.text: Are you going to Einbroch to complete basic training?
scripts.translation: 你要去艾音布羅克完成基礎訓練嗎？

scripts.text: Can you help me get to Einbroch?
scripts.translation: 能送我去艾音布羅克嗎？

scripts.text: No, I have other things to do.
scripts.translation: 不了，我還有別的事要辦。

scripts.text: Sure, why not? Make sure to spend some time trainin!
scripts.translation: 當然行！記得多花點時間練習！

scripts.text: Oh, is that so? If you wish to go to Einbroch but not take the Airship, come speak to me.
scripts.translation: 哦，是嗎？如果你想去艾音布羅克又不打算搭飛空艇，就來找

scripts.text: Because you're still training, I will send you there for free.
scripts.translation: 我。你還在訓練，我可以免費送你過去。

scripts.text: Ah you're back, and now wearing lovely Gunslinger clothing! It suits you well, congratulations!
scripts.translation: 喲，你回來啦，還穿上了帥氣的神槍手服裝！很適合你，恭喜！

scripts.text: I just received the news from my brother regarding your achievement of completing basic training.
scripts.translation: 我剛收到哥哥的訊息，聽說你已經完成基礎訓練了。

scripts.text: Huh? My brother did not tell you? My brother is the one in charge of Basic Training.
scripts.translation: 咦？我哥哥沒告訴你嗎？基礎訓練就是由他負責的。

scripts.text: Louie and Lusa are very similar names, right?
scripts.translation: 路易和露莎這兩個名字很像，對吧？

scripts.text: Ha ha~ Well, our relationship is not really that important.
scripts.translation: 哈哈～算了，我們是什麼關係也沒那麼重要。

scripts.text: I have been assigned to conduct Combat Training for the Gunslinger guild.
scripts.translation: 我受命負責神槍手公會的戰鬥訓練。

scripts.text: Gunslingers are very fond of freedom, so the Guild had limited choices to choose from.
scripts.translation: 神槍手向來崇尚自由，所以公會能挑的人選不多。

scripts.text: They suddenly called me to do this. Frankly I think it's a bit absurd.
scripts.translation: 他們突然把我叫來負責這事。說實話，我覺得有點莫名其妙。

scripts.text: But on the basis of there being no previous Combat Training before, I have agreed to help.
scripts.translation: 不過，之前一直沒有戰鬥訓練，既然如此，我就答應幫忙了。

scripts.text: So it was decided that we would use this opporunity to help get rid of some of the monsters near Prontera and Izlude.
scripts.translation: 於是我們決定借這個機會，清理普隆德拉和依斯魯得島附近的魔物。

scripts.text: It should help the people of those areas that are plagued by the same monsters every day.
scripts.translation: 這樣也能幫幫那些每天都受同一批魔物侵擾的居民。

scripts.text: In accordance with the principles of guilds, the Combat Training is not mandatory.
scripts.translation: 公會有公會的規矩，戰鬥訓練並非強制參加。

scripts.text: Once you complete a task, talk to me again to complete to process.
scripts.translation: 每完成一項任務，再來找我確認一下就行。

scripts.text: Well that's all! If a task proves to be too difficult you can cancel at any time, so please don't worry.
scripts.translation: 就這些！任務太難的話，隨時都可以取消，不用擔心。

scripts.text: Haven't started your basic combat training yet have you? What do you want to know about training?
scripts.translation: 你還沒開始基礎戰鬥訓練吧？想了解訓練的哪方面？

scripts.text: How long can I train for?
scripts.translation: 訓練能參加到什麼時候？

scripts.text: Where do I receive tasks for training?

scripts.translation: 為什麼要參加戰鬥訓練？

scripts.text: Basic combat training can be performed until Base Level 20.
scripts.translation: 基礎戰鬥訓練可以參加到基礎等級20級。

scripts.text: You must've thought that the training would be pretty low because this is still the beginning.
scripts.translation: 你大概以為這只是初級訓練，難度不會太高吧？

scripts.text: Sorry! Did I not mention this?
scripts.translation: 抱歉！我沒跟你說過這事嗎？

scripts.text: You can choose any task you wish from the requests on my desk near the entrance.
scripts.translation: 入口附近的桌上放著任務委託，你想接哪個都行。

scripts.text: Right, ah, why? Well, The Gunslinger guild didn't have any combat training in the beginning.
scripts.translation: 對了，為什麼會有這項訓練呢？神槍手公會一開始可沒有戰鬥訓練。

scripts.text: So they suddenly asked me to perform combat training for new recruits.
scripts.translation: 所以他們突然請我來給新手做戰鬥訓練。

scripts.text: This training is not mandatory if you do not want to do it.
scripts.translation: 不想參加的話，這項訓練也不是強制的。

scripts.text: Wow! You did perfectly! I have confirmed the 10 Hornets. Kids will be happy.
scripts.translation: 哇，做得真漂亮！我確認過了，10只蜂兵都處理好了。孩子們會高興的。

scripts.text: After looking over the report, you receive experience and a Kafra Storage Coupon.
scripts.translation: 檢視報告後，你獲得了經驗值和一張卡普拉倉庫免費利用券。

scripts.text: Wow! You did perfect! I have confirmed the 10 Roda Frogs. Tonight I should get a good sleep.
scripts.translation: 哇，幹得漂亮！我確認過了，10只羅達蛙都處理好了。今晚我總算能睡個好覺了。

scripts.text: After looking over the report, you receive experience and a Kafra Storage Coupon.
scripts.translation: 檢視報告後，你獲得了經驗值和一張卡普拉倉庫免費利用券。

scripts.text: Wow! You did perfect! I have confirm the 10 Savage Babes. Students who want to develop specialist pets must be very happy.
scripts.translation: 哇，幹得漂亮！我確認過了，10只小野豬都處理好了。想培養專精寵物的學員一定會很開心。

scripts.text: After looking over the report, you receive experience and a Kafra Storage Coupon.
scripts.translation: 檢視報告後，你獲得了經驗值和一張卡普拉倉庫免費利用券。

scripts.text: Wow! You did perfect! I have confirmed the 10 Rockers. Were they hard to catch?
scripts.translation: 哇，幹得漂亮！我確認過了，10只蝗蟲都處理好了。抓起來很費勁吧？

scripts.text: After looking over the report, you receive experience and a Kafra Storage Coupon.
scripts.translation: 檢視報告後，你獲得了經驗值和一張卡普拉倉庫免費利用券。

scripts.text: I have finished processing your completed tasks. Would you like to cancel any existing tasks?
scripts.translation: 我已經處理完你完成的任務了。要取消還沒完成的任務嗎？

scripts.text: Okay, good luck continuing your training!
Huh? You do not have any assignments to cancel. Are you sure you have them?
scripts.translation: 咦？你沒有正在進行、可以取消的任務呀。確定有接任務嗎？

scripts.text: You still have some assignments, are they too difficult? Do you want to cancel them?
scripts.translation: 你還有任務沒完成，是不是太難了？要取消嗎？
那就繼續努力，拿出點本事來！

scripts.text: Hornets are not easy to deal with, huh? Do you want to cancel the assignment?
scripts.translation: 蜂兵不太好對付吧？要取消這項任務嗎？

scripts.text: If you do cancel the assignment, you will be unable to receive the reward you know?
scripts.translation: 取消任務的話，就拿不到獎勵了，知道嗎？

scripts.text: I have cancelled <Assignment A>. Now you don't have to worry about it.
scripts.translation: 我已經取消<任務A>了，這下不用擔心了。

scripts.text: You are also currently doing <Assignment B>.
Roda Frogs are not easy to deal with, huh? Do you want to cancel the assignment?
scripts.translation: 羅達蛙不太好對付吧？要取消這項任務嗎？

scripts.text: If you do cancel the assignment, you will be unable to receive the reward you know?
scripts.translation: 取消任務的話，就拿不到獎勵了，知道嗎？

scripts.text: Oh... Roda Frogs are too tough?
scripts.translation: 哦...羅達蛙太難對付了嗎？

scripts.text: I have cancelled <Assignment B>. Now you don't have to worry about it.
scripts.translation: 我已經取消<任務B>了，這下不用擔心了。

scripts.text: You are also currently doing <Assignment C>.
Savage Babe are not easy to deal with, huh? Do you want to cancel the assignment?
scripts.translation: 小野豬不太好對付吧？要取消這項任務嗎？

scripts.text: If you do cancel the assignment, you will be unable to receive the reward you know?
scripts.translation: 取消任務的話，就拿不到獎勵了，知道嗎？

scripts.text: Oh... Savage Babe are too tough?
scripts.translation: 哦...小野豬太難對付了嗎？

scripts.text: I have cancelled <Assignment C>. Now you don't have to worry about it.
scripts.translation: 我已經取消<任務C>了，這下不用擔心了。

scripts.text: You are also currently doing <Assignment D>.
scripts.translation: 你也正在進行<任務D>。[露莎]蝗蟲不太好對付吧？要取消這項任務嗎？

scripts.text: Rockers are not easy to deal with, huh? Do you want to cancel the assignment?
scripts.translation: [露莎]蝗蟲不太好對付吧？要取消這項任務嗎？

scripts.text: If you do cancel the assignment, you will be unable to receive the reward you know?
scripts.translation: 取消任務的話，就拿不到獎勵了，知道嗎？

scripts.text: I have cancelled <Assignment D>. Now you don't have to worry about it.
scripts.translation: 我已經取消<任務D>了，這下不用擔心了。

scripts.text: I have cancelled all the assignments you wished to cancel. If you have a hard time with any others, please come see me.
scripts.translation: 你想取消的任務都已取消。其他任務如果做起來有困難，記得來找我。

scripts.text: Times flies, your basic training is coming to an end!
scripts.translation: 時間過得真快，你的基礎訓練快結束了！

scripts.text: You have worked hard during this period! You have become a good marksman.
scripts.translation: 這段時間辛苦了！你已經成長為一名出色的射手。

scripts.text: However, you have still not completed your tasks.
scripts.translation: 不過，你還有任務沒有完成。

scripts.text: You cannot receive any rewards if you do not complete the tasks assigned to you.
scripts.translation: 分配給你的任務都完成後，才能領取獎勵。

scripts.text: After looking over the report, you receive experience and a Kafra Storage Coupon.
scripts.translation: 檢視報告後，你獲得了經驗值和一張卡普拉倉庫免費利用券。

scripts.text: Your Gunslinger basic training is now over.
scripts.translation: 你的神槍手基礎訓練到此結束。

scripts.text: Oh my god! It's you again!
Same old, same old. Every day teaching newbies about Gunslingers. But I love it.
scripts.translation: 還是老樣子，每天教新人神槍手的知識。不過我挺喜歡這份工作。

scripts.text: Oh yeah! My brother said he hasn't seen you for a long time. Be sure to take some time to visit him.
scripts.translation: 對了！我哥哥說好久沒見到你了，記得抽空去看看他。

scripts.text: Howdy! It's nice to see you again.
Huh! You seem to have transferred into a different class, why have you come here?
scripts.translation: 咦，你好像轉成別的職業了，怎麼又來這兒了？

scripts.text: Huh? Huh? Where are you going?
You cannot have more than one job. But you seem really serious to learn.
scripts.translation: 一個人不能同時擁有兩個職業。不過你看起來是真的很想學。

scripts.text: Since this is my job, and because it's no trouble, I will give you a simple explaination!
scripts.translation: 反正這是我的工作，也不費事，我就給你簡單講講吧！

scripts.text: Gunslingers is a class with long-range attacks. However, unlike arrows, bullets are expensive. This tends to give beginners some reason for concern.
scripts.translation: 神槍手擅長遠端攻擊。不過子彈不像箭矢那麼便宜，所以新手常會為彈藥發愁。

scripts.text: Isn't that a little too simple?
Huh, is it? What else do you want to know?
scripts.translation: 咦，是嗎？你還想了解什麼？

scripts.text: Gunslingers is a long-range attack class, so hand agility (DEX) will be very important.
scripts.translation: 神槍手是遠端攻擊職業，所以靈巧（DEX）非常重要。

scripts.text: If you want to increase your attack power, then you must strengthen your hands.
scripts.translation: 想提高攻擊力，就得提升力量屬性。

scripts.text: Gunslinger skills are not like other classes. Each weapon type has skills that can be specifically used with them.
scripts.translation: 神槍手的技能和其他職業不太一樣，每種武器都有專屬技能。

scripts.text: Like with other classes, there is no standard toward which skills you should learn.
scripts.translation: 和其他職業一樣，技能沒有固定的學習路線，按自己的想法選擇就行。

scripts.text: Gunslingers have five different kinds of guns.
scripts.translation: 神槍手可以使用五種不同的槍械。

scripts.text: Revolvers have low hit rates, but the attack speed is fast.
scripts.translation: 左輪手槍命中率較低，但攻擊速度很快。

scripts.text: Rifles are average in their performance, and is typically the weapon of choice for new Gunslingers.
scripts.translation: 步槍效能均衡，通常是新手神槍手的首選。

scripts.text: Shotguns have strong attack power, but pretty low attack speeds.
scripts.translation: 霰彈槍攻擊力很強，但攻擊速度比較慢。

scripts.text: Gatling guns have quite a fast attack speed, but the attack power is low.
scripts.translation: 加特林機槍射速很快，但攻擊力較低。

scripts.text: Gernade Launchers can be used for strong ground attacks, but the bullets will be consumed quickly.
scripts.translation: 榴彈發射器可以發動強力的範圍攻擊，不過彈藥消耗得很快。

scripts.text: Phew~ I hope I answered all your questions. This is the first time I've seen someone want to study other classes.
scripts.translation: 呼～希望這些回答能解決你的疑問。我還是頭一回碰到想了解其他職業的人。

scripts.text: Do you have any other questions?
Phew~ I hope I answered all your questions. This is the first time I've seen someone want to study other classes.
scripts.translation: 呼～希望這些回答能解決你的疑問。我還是頭一回碰到想了解其他職業的人。

scripts.text: There are lots of files on the desk, they seem to be tasks from Prontera and Izlude residents.
scripts.translation: 桌上堆著許多檔案，似乎是普隆德拉和依斯魯得島居民提交的任務委託。

scripts.text: There is a stack of papers on the desk.
On the outskirts of the village is a very bad Hornet, because of this, the children cannot play outside. Please get rid of 10 Hornets.
scripts.translation: ：孩子們村莊邊緣有隻兇惡的蜂兵，害得孩子們都不能在外面玩耍。請消滅10只蜂兵。

scripts.text: You have received ^A2563E<Assignment A>^000000 details. Please press ALT + U to check them.
scripts.translation: 你已收到<任務A>的詳細資訊。按 Alt + U 可以檢視。 ^A2563E^000000

scripts.text: I am already doing this task currently. Lusa said if I ever wanted to abondon the assignment that I should talk to her.
scripts.translation: 我正在進行這項任務。露莎說，如果想放棄，就去找她談談。

scripts.text: I have already completed this assignment. I should talk to Lusa for my reward.
scripts.translation: 我已經完成這項任務了，該去找露莎領取獎勵。

scripts.text: Recently, Roda Frogs have been keeping me awake at night. Get rid of 10 Roda Frogs so I can get a good nights rest.
scripts.translation: 民 H最近羅達蛙總在夜裡吵得我睡不著。請消滅10只羅達蛙，讓我能睡個好覺。

scripts.text: You have received ^A2563E<Assignment B>^000000 details. Please press ALT + U to check them.
scripts.translation: 你已收到<任務B>的詳細資訊。按 Alt + U 可以檢視。 ^A2563E^000000

scripts.text: I am already doing this task currently. Lusa said if I ever wanted to abondon the assignment that I should talk to her.
scripts.translation: 我正在進行這項任務。露莎說，如果想放棄，就去找她談談。

scripts.text: I have already completed this assignment. I should talk to Lusa for my reward.
scripts.translation: 我已經完成這項任務了，該去找露莎領取獎勵。

scripts.text: I want a cute pet of my own to walk around with. Can you help me catch 10 Savage Babes?
scripts.translation: 學員我想養一隻可愛的寵物陪在身邊。能幫我抓10只小野豬嗎？

scripts.text: You have received ^A2563E<Assignment C>^000000 details. Please press ALT + U to check them.
scripts.translation: 你已收到<任務C>的詳細資訊。按 Alt + U 可以檢視。 ^A2563E^000000

scripts.text: I am already doing this task currently. Lusa said if I ever wanted to abondon the assignment that I should talk to her.
scripts.translation: 我正在進行這項任務。露莎說，如果想放棄，就去找她談談。

scripts.text: I have already completed this assignment. I should talk to Lusa for my reward.
scripts.translation: 我已經完成這項任務了，該去找露莎領取獎勵。

scripts.text: I heard some Rockers were having a singing contest, but I got lost, can you help me catch 10 Rockers? One day Rockers will disappear from the world!
scripts.translation: 人聽說有些蝗蟲在舉辦歌唱比賽，可我迷路了。能幫我抓10只蝗蟲嗎？總有一天，我要讓蝗蟲從世上消失！

scripts.text: You have received ^A2563E<Assignment D>^000000 details. Please press ALT + U to check them.
scripts.translation: 你已收到<任務D>的詳細資訊。按 Alt + U 可以檢視。 ^A2563E^000000

scripts.text: I am already doing this task currently. Lusa said if I ever wanted to abondon the assignment that I should talk to her.
scripts.translation: 我正在進行這項任務。露莎說，如果想放棄，就去找她談談。

scripts.text: I have already completed this assignment. I should talk to Lusa for my reward.
scripts.translation: 我已經完成這項任務了，該去找露莎領取獎勵。

scripts.text: There are lots of files on the desk, they seem to be tasks from Prontera and Izlude residents.
scripts.translation: 桌上堆著許多檔案，似乎是普隆德拉和依斯魯得島居民提交的任務委託。

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items. -
Yesssssss? I wass sssent by the academy.
I am ^A2563ESharp Snake's Fang^000000 from the Gunslinger Guild. What do you need?
scripts.translation: 我是神槍手公會的銳利的蛇牙。有什麼事？ ^A2563E^000000

scripts.text: You seem to be that guy our brother mentioned.
scripts.translation: 你就是哥哥提到的那個人吧。

scripts.text: You don't need to worry, he said you're doing great!
scripts.translation: 別擔心，他說你表現得很出色！

scripts.text: Do you wish to exchange your guild issued weapon?
scripts.translation: 你想更換公會配發的武器嗎？

scripts.text: Let's first check your gun's condition.
scripts.translation: 先讓我檢查一下你的槍。

scripts.text: If you want to proceed, you need to have your weapon equipped.
scripts.translation: 要繼續的話，得先把武器裝備上。

scripts.text: You want to exchange your Guild issued Revolver?
scripts.translation: 你想更換公會配發的左輪手槍嗎？

scripts.text: You want to exchange your Guild issued Rifle?
scripts.translation: 你想更換公會配發的步槍嗎？

scripts.text: You want to exchange your Guild issued Shotgun?
scripts.translation: 你想更換公會配發的霰彈槍嗎？

scripts.text: You want to exchange your Guild issued Gatling Gun?
scripts.translation: 你想更換公會配發的加特林機槍嗎？

scripts.text: You want to exchange your Guild issued Grenade Launcher?
scripts.translation: 你想更換公會配發的榴彈發射器嗎？

scripts.text: The gun you are using is was not provided by the guild.
scripts.translation: 你現在用的這把槍不是公會配發的。

scripts.text: The gun looks to be in good condition.
scripts.translation: 這把槍看起來保養得不錯。

scripts.text: Please select the novice weapon you wish to exchange for your {0}!
scripts.translation: 請選擇要用來換取你這把的初心者武器！ {0}

scripts.text: You already have that gun, just use it!
scripts.translation: 你已經有這把槍了，直接用就行！

scripts.text: It's time to choose your job? How about Taekwon {0}? You may be a nice adult like me.
scripts.translation: 是時候選職業了吧？考慮一下跆拳怎麼樣？你也可以像我一樣成為出色的大人。 {0}

scripts.text: I want to follow the Taekwon way!!!
Do you want to know about taekwon boy/girl? You want to be a cool guy like me right?
scripts.translation: 想了解跆拳少年/少女嗎？你也想像我一樣成為帥氣的人吧？

scripts.text: Make the world wonderful by making a strong body with the right spirit. That's the Taekwondo motto!
scripts.translation: 以正確的精神鍛鍊強健的體魄，讓世界變得更美好。這就是跆拳道的座右銘！

scripts.text: Later if you are trained to be a stronger body, you can change your job to ^FF0000Taekwon Master^000000 or a ^FF0000Soul Linker ^000000.
scripts.translation: 等你把身體鍛鍊得更強健，就可以轉職為拳聖或悟靈士。 ^FF0000^000000^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: It is not an easy way. So I don't like to recommend it to you if you aren't fully prepared. But it is definitely a nice and great way to follow!!
scripts.translation: 這條路可不輕鬆，沒做好準備的話，我可不建議你走。不過，只要下定決心，這絕對是一條很棒的路！

scripts.text: Introduction to the class may let you know about what Taekwon in more detail.
scripts.translation: 職業介紹能讓你更深入地瞭解跆拳。

scripts.text: If you are really anxious about Taekown, I would like to recommend you a brief introduction. Will you use it?
scripts.translation: 如果你特別想了解跆拳，我可以給你一份簡要介紹。要看看嗎？

scripts.text: Every adventurer may have their own job! Hope you can find what you want!
scripts.translation: 每位冒險者都有自己的職業道路！希望你能找到心儀的職業！

scripts.text: Go to the [Misc] tab on Skill Window after equipping the Manual and there you will see some skills.
scripts.translation: 裝備手冊後，開啟技能視窗並切換到[其他]標籤頁，就能看到一些技能。

scripts.text: ^FF0000Flying Kick^000000 is the skill to approach rapidly and attack the enemy! It fully contains the typical feature of Taekwon!
scripts.translation: 飛腳踢可以迅速接近敵人並發動攻擊！這招充分體現了跆拳的特色！ ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: ^FF0000Warm Wind^000000 is the skill to change the feature of attacks. This is the essential skill for ^FF0000Taekwon unable to use weapons^000000.
scripts.translation: 暖風可以改變攻擊的屬性，是無法使用武器的跆拳職業必學的技能。 ^FF0000^000000^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: While taking the Quest, experience the skills of a Taekwon! You could meet an adept trainer on the 1st floor.
scripts.translation: 接下任務，親自體驗跆拳技能吧！一樓就有位資深教練。

scripts.text: Want to follow the Taekwon way? Let me see....
